# https://www.census.gov/retail/marts/www/martsdates.pdf

Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services Scheduled Release Dates

The scheduled dates for the Advance Monthly Retail Trade Reports for 2023/2024 are as follows:

| Data Month | Release Date | Release Time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| October 2023 | November 15, 2023 | 8:30 am |
| November 2023 | December 14, 2023 | 8:30 am |
| December 2023 | January 17, 2024 | 8:30 am |

Source: Retail Indicators Branch, U.S. Census Bureau
